facts.fact: The Secretary-General of the Ministry of National Education states on 4 November 2025 that SOSUP's online national identification of enrolled learners for school year 2025/2026 covers public and private pre-primary, primary and secondary schools; the communiqué is issued ahead of its launch.
facts.system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Apprenants scolarisés (SOSUP)

facts.fact: The communiqué describes an identification of each enrolled learner carried out online once for the school year 2025/2026, open only to pupils of schools that have themselves been identified; it does not say whether the entry is made at the school or by the family.
facts.system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Apprenants scolarisés (SOSUP)

facts.fact: The ministry says the list of schools that completed identification is posted on SOSUP's site but gives no count or total; these are schools registered through an online form, not schools entering learner data, and a second registration window runs from 5 to 30 November 2025 for those that had not registered.
facts.system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Apprenants scolarisés (SOSUP)

facts.fact: The operation is run by the Secrétariat d'Orientation Scolaire, Universitaire et Professionnelle (SOSUP), set up by decree in 2019 and reorganised in 2021, and is announced by the ministry's Secretary-General as compulsory and a condition for sitting national examinations.
facts.system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Apprenants scolarisés (SOSUP)

facts.fact: On 4 November 2025 the ministry opened a second phase of school identification, 5 to 30 November 2025, announced the online learner identification for 2025/2026 and a control mission to enforce it, and barred pupils of unidentified schools from the learner identification.
facts.system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Apprenants scolarisés (SOSUP)

systems.system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Apprenants scolarisés (SOSUP)
systems.platform: online; school registration by Google Forms and a Google Sites page
systems.tiers: public and private pre-primary, primary and secondary schools, nationally

note: Classed emis as a yearly learner register: the communiqué describes identification of each enrolled learner per school year; it gives no figure for schools or learners.
